entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have a VeloBand Cadence Sensor and I... I think I need to return it. The website was a little confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Gable, and the order number is... VF78810. I got it a couple of weeks ago.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, about 18 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it works fine. It's just... I guess I changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and I just don't use it like I thought I would. I was looking online and got so confused, I was worried I'd have to find some resale site or something... Can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. No need to worry about that, I can definitely clarify the process. Let me just check our official return policy for you.
Okay, I've got it here. Our knowledge base states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they are in their original condition.
Oh, 90 days? Really? That's a relief.

Yes, that's correct. Since you're only on day 18, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Wow, thank you so much! I was so overwhelmed trying to figure it out. That's a huge help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Charlie!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
